column1: # OSD fit (scripts/osd_fit.py, run by ./dev.py build and fw_gates osdfit): the widest text each fixed-width box row can draw.
# One cell per character (AwtoPutChar, cell font). Rule: col + width <= limit; limit = the box's last free cell + 1
# (framed boxes: cols - 1, the last cell sits under the frame).
# text: tokens joined by " ++ ": lit:TEXT | ct:EXPR (tAwtoCardS[EXPR]) | ct:EXPR..EXPR (the longest of that range, inclusive)
# EXPR / col / limit: integers or #define names of fw/osd/console.c and RL6449_Project.h, + - only.
